contribution_requirements: Work on feat/kelza-platform-foundation branch. Commit message: feat(product): implement The Insight transition from cinematic opening to product experience. Do NOT push.
key_patterns: Scenes are classes with getId(), setUniverse(), load(), enter(), update(), leave(), destroy(), isCompleted() methods
SceneDirector manages emotional phases with startTime, duration, onEnter/onUpdate/onLeave callbacks
Engine.js checkSceneTransition() polls scene completion to trigger next transition
ScrollManager wraps Lenis with lock()/unlock() for scroll control
UniverseEngine exposes setFogActive(), setGradientsActive(), setCameraDriftActive(), setVignetteActive()
CSS uses design tokens from variables.css exclusively - no hardcoded values
main.css imports all CSS modules via @import
Particles have vx/vy velocities that can be damped per-frame (Scene011 already does this in updateIntimacy)
ParticleEngine has no global speed multiplier - damping must happen per-particle in update loops
directory_structure: Root: index.html, vite.config.js, package.json. js/: app.js entry, config/ (constants, settings), engine/ (Engine, managers, universe/), scenes/ (Scene001-011), ui/ (empty), utils/. css/: main.css imports reset, variables, typography, layout, utilities, animations, universe, background, particles, lighting, fog, vignette, components.
